item.title: Starchild Launches x402 Payments for AI Agent Marketplace
item.summary: Starchild has introduced x402 payment functionality to its agent marketplace, allowing AI agents to publish services, receive payments, and conduct transactions directly through their Starchild wallets. The x402 integration enables Starchild agents to operate as both buyers and sellers, allowing them to monetize services and process direct onchain payments within the marketplace.
